name: roof_curve
description: Segmented curved roof (分段曲线屋顶): discretizes an arbitrary-curvature slope into named run:rise segments (六段式屋面曲线法: s4=4:1, s3=3:1, s2=2:1 shallow treads / s1=1:1 45° stairs / d2=1:2 stacked pairs), ordered 起步区(檐口最缓,长)→缓冲区(中段,主要切换)→冲刺区(近脊最陡,短). Segment boundaries get automatic slope blending (斜率混淆: 交界±1步互插邻段步距,纯增量置换,总高不变,消除屋面骨折); every profile keeps adjacent-segment rise ratio ≤2. Solid-core ridge + step-in follow gable_roof convention (E8: no floating slab ridge). Ratios are conservative integers estimated from tutorial images — re-calibrate if the original text page surfaces.
when_to_use: Any curved-profile gable roof: Chinese 举折/卷棚, elven organic curves, or any style whose roof silhouette must accelerate eave→ridge instead of a straight 45° pitch. Place walls first; origin = wall footprint NW corner, y = first layer ABOVE the top wall block. For spans where a hard two-pitch kink is acceptable (or required, e.g. pre-唐破风 Japanese), use gambrel_roof instead. ALL stair facing/half derived by the script — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).

origin.notes: world coords of the wall footprint corner the roof sits on; y = roof base layer

depth.notes: wall footprint along z (the slope span); span/2 must be ≥ max(4, profile segment count)

axis.notes: ridge direction; the gable ends face the OTHER axis

profile.notes: baked segment tables: classic_chinese=[s4 30%, s2 30%, s1 25%, d2 15%] 中式举折加速曲线; gentle=[s4 40%, s3 35%, s2 25%] 大跨低顶缓曲线; steep=[s2 35%, s1 40%, d2 25%] 小体量高脊陡曲线. Segments/counts are baked — do NOT pass raw ratios

material.notes: any *_stairs; tread slabs derive as material.replace('_stairs','_slab')

ridge_material.notes: slab used on the ridge row

ridge_support.notes: solid core column under the ridge (odd span) — never leave the ridge floating

end_fill.notes: wall material to fill the curved gable-end walls inside the footprint; empty = open gables
